gemini_claim: Role/auth denials are silent, unlike require_super_admin which logs ACCESS_DENIED.
implementation_summary: Added security_audit_service.log_access_denied for unauthenticated and insufficient_role denials in require_operator_or_above, and unauthenticated denials in require_active_user, reusing _denied_event_for(path). Behavior unchanged (still raises 401/403).
notes: require_active_user covers the whole product surface; denial audit can amplify under unauthenticated floods. Best-effort/non-blocking; consider sampling if abused.

gemini_claim: log_buffer captures only app.* loggers, so the top-level security.audit logger never reaches the backend sidebar.
implementation_summary: No change. The buffer handler is attached to the ROOT logger; security.audit propagates to root (no propagate=False anywhere) and get_backend_logs returns the snapshot with no logger-name filter. Proven at runtime inside aivideo-backend-1: emitting a security.audit record produced exactly one buffer entry with logger=='security.audit'.
tests_run: runtime check in aivideo-backend-1 (log_buffer.install + security.audit logger -> buffer.snapshot)
notes: Adding a dedicated handler to security.audit would have double-captured records. Deliberately not done.

gemini_claim: delete_secret is silent; deleting credentials has no audit event.
implementation_summary: Bound request + actor (require_super_admin) and emit SECRET_DELETED (result=success on delete, result=not_found on 404). Logs only key_name; the secret value is never logged.
notes: Test asserts the secret value never appears in any audit record.

gemini_claim: Login and registration submit/success/failure are invisible in logBus.
implementation_summary: Added logBus.emit for submitted/success/failed on both pages, following the CreateJobForm convention. Only username (identifier) is logged; never password/confirm/token.
notes: No auth response, token, or password is included in any emitted meta.

gemini_claim: Character create/edit/delete are silent in logBus (pointed at CharacterForm.tsx and characters/[id]/page.tsx).
implementation_summary: Added submitted/success/failed emits at the real call sites (the pages). CharacterForm.tsx is a presentational controlled form and does not call the API, so emits there would be wrong. Only character_id/name are logged.
notes: Gemini's file pointers were slightly off; underlying finding was valid.

gemini_claim: Upserting/testing/deleting API keys is not reported to logBus.
implementation_summary: Added submitted/success/failed emits for save, test, delete. Only key_name and test status are logged; the secret value (row.value) is never emitted.

gemini_claim: Changing UI language or API base URL may not be reported consistently.
implementation_summary: No change. SettingsContext already emits on apiBaseUrl change, reset, and load; SettingsPanel emits on connection/port tests. Only the i18n language toggle is not emitted (cosmetic, non-security).
notes: Language-toggle logBus event left as optional backlog.

function_or_component: create_job endpoint, generate_image endpoint, request middleware
gemini_claim: Standard logs (jobs.create_endpoint.start, characters.generate_image.start, request.start) carry rid but not user_id.
implementation_summary: Option A (minimal): bound the auth dependency as a parameter on create_job and the character image endpoint and added user_id to their start/done logs. request.start intentionally still lacks user_id because the middleware runs before auth resolves (documented, acceptable). Moved create_job's operator guard from decorator to parameter to avoid double-executing the dependency.
notes: No contextvar/middleware rewrite (avoided over-engineering per brief).

gemini_claim: set_job_status is silent; terminal states should be logged at the service layer.
implementation_summary: Added a single transition log (old -> new, terminal flag); WARNING level when status == failed. Includes job_id in structured extra.
notes: Single log per transition; not noisy.

gemini_claim: Raises ValueError on traversal/safety violation but does not log the security signal.
implementation_summary: Added module logger and WARNING on the two security-relevant violations (path traversal '..' and outside-allowed-roots). The path is a filesystem location, not a credential, so it is safe to log. Format/empty/extension validation errors are NOT logged (ordinary input errors, would be noisy).

No change. register/login are audited in auth.py (REGISTER_CREATED_PENDING, REGISTER_REJECTED_*, LOGIN_*). approve/reject/suspend/reactivate/soft_delete are audited in users.py via _run_transition -> log_user_admin_event with actor, target, old/new status+role on both success and denial. Adding service-layer logs would duplicate and add noise.
notes: Docstrings were still added to these functions (see R4-009).

gemini_claim: Character status update is logged at the API layer but not where the transition occurs.
implementation_summary: No change. The transition is logged at characters.py:182 (characters.status.done id=... -> ...). A service-layer duplicate would be redundant. Docstring already present on transition_status.

gemini_claim: Listing users is not logged as an audit event.
implementation_summary: Added USER_LIST_VIEWED and USER_PENDING_VIEWED audit events (consistent with the existing SECRET_LIST_VIEWED). Safe because the admin users page does not poll on an interval, so this does not spam the audit table.

gemini_claim: 62% of backend functions undocumented; user_service ~90%; job_service create/get/set_status; character lifecycle.
implementation_summary: Added concise docstrings (purpose, invariants, state transitions, side effects, raised errors) to the critical/exported functions only: user_service register_user/list_users/approve/reject/suspend/reactivate/soft_delete; job_service create_job/get_job/set_job_status; character_service create_character/update_character/soft_delete_character; jobs.list_jobs; providers.list_providers/_merge. Trivial helpers intentionally left undocumented.
notes: Not all 505 functions documented (per brief). A required-docstrings linter remains optional future work.

gemini_claim: No hardcoded secrets found; verify standard loggers don't log full payloads; frontend API logs are safe.
implementation_summary: No change required. security_audit_service.redact() covers password/token/secret/api_key/authorization keys recursively and is applied before logging/persisting. Verified that all NEW logs added in this pass emit only non-sensitive identifiers (user_id, key_name, username, character_id, job_id, filesystem paths) and never values/passwords/tokens/payloads. A test asserts the deleted secret value never appears in audit records.

gemini_claim: Panels work; backend panel does not show security.audit; only missing feeds/events need fixing.
implementation_summary: No UI change. The security.audit gap is invalid (see R4-002). The missing user/action feeds are addressed by the frontend logBus additions (R4-004/005/006). Tabs, filters, and export are unchanged.
notes: No tab merge / redesign per brief.

gemini_claim: Run targeted tests; produce Markdown + JSON reports.
implementation_summary: Added 2 tests (operator-route denial audit; secret-delete audit + no-value-leak). Ran 137 backend tests across auth/RBAC/audit/secrets/jobs/characters/path-safety (all pass), plus frontend tsc + lint (clean) and py_compile on all changed backend files. Produced this JSON and the Markdown report.
notes: Tests run in a throwaway container from aivideo-backend:latest with the host repo mounted at /app (editable installs make edits live); host has no Python test toolchain.
